 Bribe contract for distributing voting rewards to VTOKEN holders that vote for plugins on the Voter contract. Rewards are distributed over 7 days. Rewards are distributed to VTOKEN holders that vote for plugins on the Voter contract. VTOKEN holders will only earn voting rewards from plugins that they vote for. VTOKEN holders get a deposit a virtual balance in the Bribe contract by voting for its corresponding plugin on the Voter contract. VTOKEN holders can withdraw their bribe balance by resetting their votes to 0.  No VTOKEN is ever stored in the Bribe contract itself, rather a virtual balance is stored when votes are cast. The virtual balance is used to calculate the amount of rewards that each VTOKEN holder is entitled to.   Each plugin has a unique corresponding Bribe contract.  Bribe balanceOf must be equal to Voter votes for that plugin for all accounts at all times. params.account: the account to deposit virtual tokens for
params.amount: the amount of virtual tokens to deposit

params.account: the account to withdraw virtual tokens for
params.amount: the amount of virtual tokens to withdraw

params._voter: the address of the voter contract

params.account: The address to claim rewards for.

params._rewardsToken: the reward token to begin distribution for
params.reward: the amount of reward tokens to distribute

_deposit(uint256,address).notice: Deposits a virtual amount of tokens for account. No tokens are actually being deposited,         this is reward accounting for voting balances. Only voter contract can call this function.

_withdraw(uint256,address).notice: Withdraws a virtual amount of tokens for account. No tokens are actually being withdrawn,         this is reward accounting for voting balances. Only voter contract can call this function.

addReward(address).notice: Adds a reward token for distribution. Only voter contract can call this function.

getReward(address).notice: Claim rewards accrued for an account. Claimed rewards are sent to the account.

notifyRewardAmount(address,uint256).notice: Begin reward distribution to accounts with non-zero balances. Transfers tokens from msg.sender         to this contract and begins accounting for distribution with new reward token rates. Anyone          can call this function on existing reward tokens.
